answer: You want 1,000 fake identities. Each one needs a sponsor chain, and that is where the money dies. An endorser locks 100 units for 12 epochs and may endorse at most 3 newcomers per epoch. Density above 0.6 or a star cluster triggers automatic review. Confirmed fraud freezes the whole chain and strips the endorser of rights for 10 epochs. An onyx of 1,000 fakes needs 34 clean endorsers staking 3,400 units, and a basalt wall of review catches 40% of them, so expected losses exceed 13,600 units. A dawn raid on one cluster exposes the rest.
